tasks.title: Lower image definitions into a reviewable build plan
tasks.goal: Compose deterministic image stages from the same environment lock and existing artifact DAG.
steps: Define ImageDefinition base/platform, lock/profile, runtime principal/home/workdir, entrypoint, ports/volumes and service-binding inputs.
Lower captured inputs into deterministic Dockerfile/context or supported BuildKit graph with separate preparation/build/realization/verification/runtime stages.
Expose exact stage/input/output provenance and bounded declared build context; diagnose opaque hand-authored escape-hatch guarantees explicitly.
positive_cases: Identical normalized input captures lower to byte-identical plan/context.
Build-only dependencies stay out of the runtime output inventory.
negative_cases: Recursive HOME/repository capture uploads undeclared credentials.
Changing a mutable tag at execution silently changes an approved base.

tasks.title: Execute BuildKit builds with structured stage evidence
tasks.goal: Run prepared image builds through the existing provider and M-16 operation/control path.
steps: Implement the BuildKit provider against the probed driver/platform/exporter capabilities, binding exact plan, worker, namespace and target IDs.
Capture structured progress, stage failure and resulting artifact identities through existing journals; cooperative cancellation preserves completed/uncertain effects.
Pass explicitly admitted secrets through supported secret/SSH mounts only; redact values from context, argv, logs, records and provenance.
positive_cases: A prepared linux/amd64 image completes with stage-to-input/output links.
A cancelled or failed build remains inspectable through operation evidence.
negative_cases: Build arguments or copied user token stores convey credentials.
A blocked tools/call prevents cancellation or independent queries.

tasks.title: Export OCI evidence and verify non-root runtime replay
tasks.goal: Demonstrate local artifact delivery and offline execution without conflating export, load and publication.
steps: Export to a local OCI artifact and inspect config/layers/manifest/index plus retained attestations/SBOM; report unavailable retention explicitly.
Load only into the admitted fixture runtime, run a captured smoke as the target ordinary user and verify installed tool and boot inventory supplied by prior groups.
Replay the prepared build with network denied under M-15-K and remove a required capture to prove an unavailable result; do not invoke public push.
positive_cases: Exported OCI retains the claimed attestations on a supported exporter.
The non-root runtime executes a captured local command offline.
negative_cases: A local image-store load silently strips evidence yet reports complete retention.
Missing source/base layer triggers an offline network fetch.
